boundary: Shared controlled local worktree with exact files and SHA256 manifest is reviewer-accessible for this task. No commit/push required.
minimum: result.json with status, source/baseline identity, scope and pending findings
source delta/manifest and exact package refs
commands/check results, focused RED/GREEN and independent correctness references
ordinary Web source/SDK/driver bindings and comparison metrics
reuse: Reference existing immutable data by exact path/hash. Do not duplicate unchanged historical source/evidence trees.
timing: Diagnostic CPU scope timings include their observation overhead. Ordinary performance must have timing/qualification off. Hardware GPU time unavailable unless actually measured. Keep null for unavailable stages.
communication: When terminal, send completion to paired control thread with result path and any blocker. This task does not request user-facing Git publication.
